Min magnitude:
Min magnitude is only applied when the randomness can be in a positive or negative direction.
It guarantees a random number generated will be at least this magnitude.
Randomness is redistributed in the range of the min magnitude to the largest random bound in that direction
The end result is clamped to the random bounds.
